preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s) and all(c in 'ab' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of letters 'a' and 'b'.
Both strings s and t have lengths between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in s) or any(c == 'a' for c in t) and any(c == 'b' for c in s) or any(c == 'b' for c in t)
preconditions.description: At least one string contains at least one 'a' and at least one string contains at least one 'b'.

postconditions.expression: all(c == 'a' for c in s) or all(c == 'b' for c in s) and all(c == 'a' for c in t) or all(c == 'b' for c in t)
postconditions.description: After performing the operations, one string consists only of 'a's and the other only of 'b's.

postconditions.expression: n == 0 or (n >= 1 and all(0 <= ai <= len(s) and 0 <= bi <= len(t) for ai, bi in operations))
postconditions.description: The number of operations n is non-negative, and each operation (ai, bi) has valid prefix lengths for s and t.

postconditions.expression: n == 0 or (n >= 1 and all(0 <= ai <= len(s) and 0 <= bi <= len(t) for ai, bi in operations))
postconditions.description: Each operation (ai, bi) in the sequence is valid, where ai and bi are the lengths of the prefixes of s and t to swap.
The number of operations n matches the number of lines in the output sequence.
